target.title: feat: disable automatic session resets by default
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw currently rolls unconfigured sessions to a new session every day at 04:00 local time. That automatic boundary discards rolling session continuity even though session state persists in SQLite, compaction already bounds the active model context, and memory layers carry durable continuity.

This is an owner-approved, compatibility-sensitive default change: compaction becomes the natural context boundary, while automatic session rollover becomes opt-in.

## Why This Change Was Made

The default reset mode is now `none`. Explicit daily and idle policies, `resetByType`, `resetByChannel`, legacy `idleMinutes`, and manual `/new` and `/reset` remain available and retain their existing behavior. Explicit reset objects that omit `mode` preserve their previous daily fallback.

The consumer sweep also found Discord thread close depended on the old timestamp-based freshness behavior. It now uses a guarded lifecycle deletion so closing a thread still archives its transcript and guarantees a fresh session on the next message under every reset mode. Pending `updatedAt: 0` reset tombstones written by older releases remain honored after upgrade.

## User Impact

Users without a configured reset policy keep one rolling session across idle gaps and calendar boundaries, with compaction managing context growth. Operators who want automatic rollover can opt into `session.reset.mode: "daily"` or `"idle"`; existing explicit schedules and compatibility settings continue to work.

Cron isolated-agent runs still receive a fresh session identity per run. That behavior is driven by run-scoped cron session creation, not the session reset default. Heartbeat and other system-event writes still do not extend explicit daily or idle freshness.

Release-note context: call out that unconfigured sessions no longer reset daily. Operators who want the former behavior should configure `session.reset: { mode: "daily", atHour: 4 }`. No changelog file is included in this contributor PR.

AI-assisted: yes. I understand and reviewed the implementation and its compatibility boundaries.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/config/sessions/reset-policy.test.ts src/config/sessions/sessions.test.ts src/config/sessions/store.session-lifecycle-mutation.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/session.heartbeat-no-reset.test.ts src/cron/isolated-agent.session-identity.test.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/thread-session-close.test.ts src/plugin-sdk/session-store-runtime.test.ts` — 261 tests passed on the final rebased head in Blacksmith Testbox.
- `pnpm tsgo:core` — passed.
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions` — passed.
- `pnpm plugin-sdk:surface:check` — passed.
- Targeted `pnpm format:check` for all touched files — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
- Autoreview branch mode against current `origin/main` — clean, no accepted/actionable findings.
